Question 8
?

Consider the ellipse centered at (3,1) with horizontal radius 1 and vertical radius 2, as shown above. Which of the following sets of parametric equations, defined for θ∈[0,2π), traverse the ellipse once in the counterclockwise direction starting at the point A(4,1)?

a
x=cos⁡θ+1,y=2sin⁡θ+3
b
x=2sin⁡θ+1,y=4cos⁡θ+3
c
x=cos⁡θ+3,y=2sin⁡θ+1
d
x=2cos⁡θ+3,y=4sin⁡θ+1
e
x=sin⁡θ+3,y=2cos⁡θ+1
